discussion_comments.comment_body:
`--config` is declared as a global argument in Cargo's CLI (`multi_opt("config", ...).global(true)` in [`src/bin/cargo/cli.rs`](https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/blob/master/src/bin/cargo/cli.rs)), so clap accepts it after the subcommand and Cargo merges it into the global config, the same as `cargo --config ... build`. The validation runs of this exact head confirm it: [488225](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=488225) (CI) and [488226](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=488226) (product) ran every one of these commands on every platform, all succeeded on the first attempt, and none of the logs has an argument error. I'm leaving the placement as is.
